scene: leaning on a bench, adjusting the sunglasses

intro.ko: 코발트 오리털 푸퍼에 검정 후디와 바랜 데님을 맞췄다. 회색 목도리와 검정 선글라스로 색을 정리했다.
intro.en: A cobalt duck-down puffer goes with a black hoodie and faded denim. A smoky grey scarf and black sunglasses keep the rest of the palette quiet.
intro.de: Zur kobaltblauen Entendaunenjacke passen ein schwarzer Hoodie und verwaschene Jeans. Ein rauchgrauer Schal und eine schwarze Sonnenbrille halten den Rest zurückhaltend.

deck.ko: 벤치에 기대 선글라스를 고쳐 쓰는, 코발트 한 벌로 색을 정한 날.
deck.en: One cobalt jacket sets the colour while you lean on the bench and settle your sunglasses.
deck.de: Eine kobaltblaue Jacke gibt die Farbe vor, während man an der Bank lehnt und die Sonnenbrille richtet.

copy.pull: ONE BRIGHT COLOUR, THE REST IN GREY.

tip.ko: 선명한 아우터 하나를 입는 날엔 나머지를 검정과 회색으로만 두어 색이 한곳에 모이게 해요.
tip.en: On a day with one vivid jacket, keep everything else black and grey so the colour sits in one place.
tip.de: Mit einer leuchtenden Jacke den Rest in Schwarz und Grau halten, damit die Farbe an einer Stelle bleibt.

copy.note: title and body are the producer copy (Korean master) verbatim; deck, pull and tip written by Claude Code from the editorial (not in the delivery)

products.spec: matte cobalt duck-down puffer with wide horizontal baffles

howToWear.ko: 푸퍼를 살짝 열어 검정 후디와 코발트 색을 함께 보여 준다.
howToWear.en: Leave the puffer open enough to show the black hoodie against cobalt blue.
howToWear.de: Die Daunenjacke etwas öffnen, damit der schwarze Hoodie zum Kobaltblau sichtbar wird.

howToWear.ko: 후드를 밖으로 빼 목 뒤에 포개어 둔다.
howToWear.en: Let the hood rest outside the puffer at the back of the neck.
howToWear.de: Die Kapuze außen aus der Jacke über den Nacken legen.

howToWear.ko: 바랜 데님을 코발트 아우터 옆의 차분한 색으로 쓴다.
howToWear.en: Use faded denim as a quiet backdrop for the cobalt jacket.
howToWear.de: Die verwaschene Jeans als ruhigen Gegenpol zur kobaltblauen Jacke tragen.

howToWear.ko: 데님 밑단을 부츠 윗부분에 가볍게 걸친다.
howToWear.en: Keep the jeans hem resting loosely on the top of the padded boots.
howToWear.de: Den Jeanssaum locker auf dem Schaft der gepolsterten Stiefeletten aufliegen lassen.

howToWear.ko: 비니의 접힌 밴드를 이마 위에 가볍게 맞춘다.
howToWear.en: Set the turn-up just above the forehead.
howToWear.de: Den Umschlag locker oberhalb der Stirn tragen.

howToWear.ko: 회색 목도리를 한 번 감아 얼굴 가까이 부드러운 색을 둔다.
howToWear.en: Wrap it once for a softer grey against the face.
howToWear.de: Einmal wickeln, damit das weiche Grau nah am Gesicht liegt.

howToWear.ko: 햇빛이 강한 벤치 옆에서 사각 선글라스를 쓴다.
howToWear.en: Wear the square frames in the bright sun by the bench.
howToWear.de: Die rechteckige Brille in der hellen Sonne an der Bank aufsetzen.

products.spec: white crew-neck undershirt with only the hem visible

howToWear.ko: 검정 후디 아래로 흰색 티 밑단만 가늘게 보이게 입는다.
howToWear.en: Leave a thin edge of white showing below the black hoodie.
howToWear.de: Unter dem schwarzen Hoodie nur einen schmalen weißen Saum zeigen.
